name: @repo/host-daemon
description: Vespin's host daemon, `vespin-host`: it runs on a Linux box or an Apple silicon Mac and follows the local agents its member starts there

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/vespin-host.mjs --define:process.env.APP_HOST_VERSION='"'$npm_package_version'"' --define:process.env.APP_HOST_SENTRY_DSN='"'${SENTRY_DSN:-}'"' --banner:js="import { createRequire as createBundleRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createBundleRequire(import.meta.url);" && node --check dist/vespin-host.mjs
scripts.smoke: pnpm run build && node dist/vespin-host.mjs version
